electrical.observation: C98 occurs in the printed C94...C98 group between +5 V and ground; no individual value or pad polarity is printed.

mounting_detail.observation: The separately captioned 'Установка C98, C100' side view depicts the component arched above a package with its two board landings marked 25* mm apart. source.observation: The diagonal C98 rectangle crosses D58, with one lead stroke extending above its left end and the other below/right beyond its right end. The separately captioned mounting detail gives 25* mm between board landings. The drawing constrains a diagonal pair spanning approximately the D58 package length, but does not number the holes or assign lead polarity.

owner.observation: Oblique overlapping view resolves marked KR580IR82 D58 and its bare right-end package top; no diagonal capacitor body is present over it.

Second view confirms no capacitor body over D58. It repeats a small upper-left soldered feature and the protruding lower-right lead/joint, forming the diagonal pair detailed in owner_candidate_pair; their hole identities and rails remain unproved.

decision: The owner board is unpopulated at the drawn over-D58 C98 body position. Two independently visible features form a source-consistent upper-left/lower-right landing-pair candidate across D58, roughly matching the 25* mm factory mounting span. Keep C98 PCB placement, population history, value, and rail polarity open until both holes and +5 V/GND continuity are proved.
next_checks: Register the upper-left feature and lower-right protruding joint on the owner solder face as the same physical holes before choosing a C98 footprint.
With power removed, meter the two features separately to known +5 V and ground contacts and verify they are distinct drilled landings.
Obtain a factory BOM/assembly instruction before assigning value or a DNP instruction.

owner_candidate_pair.observation: Both owner angles show a small filled feature just above D58's left-end top contact and a separate protruding soldered lead/joint below its right end. Their upper-left to lower-right diagonal matches the two .009 C98 lead strokes. No C98 body bridges them on this photographed board.
owner_candidate_pair.pitch_check: The pair spans roughly 623 px in the first view and 631 px in the second. D58's nine 2.54 mm pin intervals span about 535/550 px in those views, giving a pair separation near 26-27 mm. Perspective, joint-center reads, and assembly drawing scale prevent treating that as a drill dimension, but it is compatible with the factory 25* mm mounting note.
owner_candidate_pair.limit: The upper feature has not been verified as a separate plated capacitor hole rather than a nearby solder/copper feature; neither feature is continuity-registered to +5 V or ground. This is a leading search pair, not a fabrication-ready pad pair or proof that C98 was ever fitted.

solder_face_search.method: Used the existing board-to-solder panorama registration to locate the D58 neighborhood, then inspected both visible DIP pin rows and surrounding solder joints in the overlapping close-up tiles.
solder_face_search.result: The visible rows and nearby joints do not uniquely identify two separate C98 drill holes. Panorama registration is search-grade here and does not establish the owner component-side features as particular solder-side joints.
solder_face_search.decision: Keep the candidate pair and both rail assignments provisional; obtain local face-to-face registration or owner continuity measurements before setting a footprint.
